method: Editorial review of original committed concept copy (hero, features and testimonials), selected page source and available private QA reports. Not a retrospective visual/browser certification of 60 pages. Assessments are editorial judgments, except where explicitly attributed to the user. Current repaired copy is not counted as evidence of original quality. Private reports may not be retained on other machines.

findings.problem: A repeatable bureaucracy voice displaced audience observation.
findings.change: Global calibration flags recurring approvals, committees, receipts and inflated titles; permits them when they earn a specific fresh consequence.

findings.problem: One premise was committed before alternatives were compared.
evidence: scripts/pipeline_editorial.py: prior CONCEPT_SCHEMA requested only one concept
findings.change: Require three different candidate premises and record a matching selection before assets.

findings.problem: Reviewer explanation could rescue flat or arbitrary published copy.
findings.change: Withhold writer rationale; require reader-visible quotes and separate source relevance, distinctness and per-feature judgments. Contradictory satire passes fail closed.

findings.problem: Human feedback was mostly scoped to particular entry slugs.
evidence: scripts/pipeline_qa.py: editorial_regressions reads the ledger for the current slug
findings.change: Apply positive and negative human calibration to every new concept, build, review and repair.

findings.problem: Logo file validity and provenance passed opaque beige exports.
findings.change: Require future raster logo exports to contain real visible artwork and transparency, with transparent corners; retain visual checks on both page backgrounds.

limits: These changes enforce evidence and workflow, not an objective machine test for funniness. Behavioral tests use simulated reviewers; no claim that a new live model run has demonstrated a lower rejection rate.
Do not automatically rewrite the remaining archive from these observations. The user requested the current page repairs and a prevention fix.

entries.original_hero: Buy your audience in bulk.
entries.observation: Bulk reaction faces and awkward food-court collaborations are concrete; comments sold in drums and 0.4-cent faces mostly substitute retail units for internet behavior.

entries.original_hero: Know exactly how good a boy he is.
entries.observation: An anxious owner measures an obviously happy dog. Recovery plans always recommending a sunny nap develop the mismatch; proprietary metric names add little.

entries.original_hero: Everything is edible. Some of it is also for sale.
entries.observation: Eating auction items creates a clear self-defeating marketplace; headbutts raising bids by mouthfuls muddle what payment means.

entries.original_hero: Your group chat, now with autocomplete.
entries.observation: Automated social avoidance and friends liking the automated personality expose recognizable insecurity through autocomplete and agents.

entries.original_hero: Finally, a match who remembers your name.
entries.observation: The therapist getting the name wrong adds an incident. Used profiles having a physical stain is literal noun substitution with no established consequence.

entries.original_hero: Ship fence firmware from the side of a cliff.
entries.observation: Eating the gate controller and celebrating velocity makes a physical consequence clear. Four stomachs as review stages relies on the pun more than a new observation.

entries.original_hero: 26.2 miles. 27 tasks. Zero excuses logged.
entries.observation: Body parts assigned tickets, hamstring standups and toenail portfolios repeatedly turn running into office administration. Detached as a toenail status is a sharper specific line.

entries.original_hero: Your all-hands is sold out. You are in the queue.
entries.observation: Dynamic pricing and fees applied to mandatory meetings generate a clear unfairness; paying to attend your own performance review extends it.

entries.original_hero: Ship your stash to the edge of the couch.
entries.observation: The passport disappearing is concrete; physical objects replicated across hiding nodes obscure what deployment does in this fictional service.

entries.original_hero: Hailing frequencies open.
entries.observation: Competing timestamps and corrections have fan relevance; canon-checking a birthday greeting has no stated trigger, and the in-law filter is a familiar add-on.

entries.original_hero: Your reception, as a database.
entries.observation: Extensive documentation failing to stop a DJ playing banned songs connects the software to a recognizable professional habit.

entries.original_hero: A little room in someone’s calendar.
entries.observation: The archived rejected lockbox/inbox and towel/scope lines show literal transplantation without meaning. Repaired scope intake communicates, but some remaining features offer routine benefits.

entries.original_hero: You cleared the dance floor. Tell your entire network.
entries.observation: Networking exposes complaints to prospective clients and vendors. The same growth mechanism that sells the service undermines the user.

entries.original_hero: Own less. Discuss it more.
entries.observation: Permanent receipts for deleted messages contain a clear contradiction; disposal workflow and enterprise entitlements dominate the joke.

entries.original_hero: A permanent home for your temporary role.
entries.observation: Inflated titles without printer access have human stakes; AI relabeling waiting as exposure and work as onboarding repeat corporate reclassification.

entries.original_hero: This meeting could have been a marathon.
entries.observation: Breathing interpreted as budget approval is arbitrary, then reused almost directly by the K-pop Zoom entry two days later. Pace rooms provide a more audience-specific social conflict.

entries.original_hero: Your pitching change deserves a six-part series.
entries.observation: Prestige editing flatters a parent-coach’s importance while trapping family viewers. The cold handshake and overlong mound walk develop different scenes.

entries.original_hero: Your bias needs a board meeting.
entries.observation: Screams as minutes repeat runner breathing as approvals. Committee roles, abstention records and action owners provide administration in place of a fresh fan interaction.

entries.original_hero:
Someone remembered.
We have the receipt.
entries.observation: Gift parity and cake naming have recognizable family stakes; attention tickets and acknowledgment dispatch use the prevailing service-administration voice.

entries.original_hero: Your cheeks are not a system of record.
entries.observation: Wheel revolutions forecasting growth while distance stays zero is clear; cheek cost bases, receipts and CFO titles repeat the audit voice.

entries.original_hero: Standing together requires alignment.
entries.observation: Approval before warmth is another arbitrary bureaucracy. A fish channel full of messages but no fish connects Slack activity to an animal’s need more directly.

entries.original_hero: Your last rep needs an audience.
entries.observation: Repaired user-approved reference. Audience scrutiny becomes timestamped rep disputes and time lost to autoplay; scenes stay understandable.

entries.original_hero: The park is public. The chip is yours.
entries.observation: Building while another goose eats the guarded chip, cosmetic visibility and defending a drain give three concrete gameplay reversals.

entries.original_hero: Your hobby needs an office.
entries.observation: Initial generic leasing and niche service copy was rejected. Current reception requiring the real name of a close online friend creates a specific social discovery.

entries.original_hero: Your dream home is blocking the hallway.
entries.observation: Imagined rooms collide with a small flat, matching search finds a dead hotel, and the housemate reveals the dumpster crop. Distinct observations.

entries.original_hero: Your clear-out needs a delivery truck.
entries.observation: Buying infrastructure to hide mugs, renting a donated drill and paint samples becoming a mural each create a different consequence.

entries.original_hero: You had brain surgery to type 'Hey.'
entries.observation: Surgery to type Hey establishes disproportionate effort. Training, editing and TV pairing expose different forms of unresolved attachment.

entries.original_hero: Open a shop for trains you won't sell.
entries.observation: Original duplicates and replacement packs return to keeping more trains. The historical-year checkout rule offers sharper seller/customer conflict. Repaired first in this change.

entries.original_hero: Your love life woke the farmer.
entries.observation: Bucket height fraud, food exploitation and boosted crow rivalry connect dating behavior with physical chicken consequences.

entries.original_hero: You took a day off to approve everyone else's.
entries.observation: Original holiday approvals lack a persuasive Steam/fan reason and recur across every main surface. Concept and final QA both passed without findings. Repaired first in this change.
